$comment: SYNTHETIC. One tool named on the deny side of a policy whose allow rule
covers the whole server — the split-brain configuration an operator writes
when they grant a server and then think better of one verb.
This fixture pins which side wins at the boundary: deny beats allow. It is
also the control for the deny rows in section B — with no working deny
anywhere in this table, B1's verdict could be read as 'deny rules do not
work here' rather than as the finding it is.
